# `octo/cardPayments`

Add `octo/cardPayments` to the `Octo-Capabilities` header to receive these fields.

## Contents

- [Endpoints](#endpoints)
- [Schemas introduced by this capability](#schemas-introduced-by-this-capability)
- [Source](#source)
- [Integration notes](#integration-notes)

## Endpoints

This capability unlocks 1 endpoint(s).

- **`GET /card_payments/{cardPaymentId}`**: Get Card Payment.
  - **cardPaymentId** (string, in path, required): Card payment identifier returned in booking/order/gift responses.

## Schemas introduced by this capability

8 schema(s) exist only when `octo/cardPayments` is active.

### `CardPayment`

Required: `status`.

Possible values: `ON_HOLD`, `CONFIRMED`, `CANCELLED`, `EXPIRED`, `REDEEMED`, `NO_SHOW`, `PENDING`, `REJECTED`, `REBOOKED`, `QUOTE` (the specification declares this set on `Booking`; here it types the field as a plain string). Example: `"CONFIRMED"`.

### Rules and conditionals

- If Ventrata has not yet received the webhook notification from Adyen then you may receive a `PAYMENT_PENDING` error code.
- If the payment is refused, you get a `BAD_REQUEST` error with the reason in `errorMessage`. ## External Gateway The external gateway lets you register a virtual card payment taken on an external processor.
